newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa all-share index closes at new high.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa all-share index closes at new high.

text.p: The South African all-share index closed on Tuesday at a new all-time high of 7,094.2 points, a gain of 51.7 points.
The previous record of 7,073.09 was set on October 15, 1996, the Johannesburg Stock Exchange said.

The market has been riding on a wave of positive sentiment stemming from a firmer rand and improved economic fundamentals since the beginning of the year. Foreigners have also been pouring money into the local market.
